spans.s:
m. (-मः)
1 The moon.
2

KUVERA.
3

A monkey chief.
4 Air, wind.
5

YAMA.
6
One of the demigods called

VASUS.
7
Ś

IVA.
8

The moon-plant, (Asclepias acida, or Sarcostema viminalis.)
9 The acid juice of the

Sarcostema.
10

A drug of supposed magical properties.
11

Water.
12

Nectar, the liquor of immortals.
13

Camphor.
14

A deified progenitor.
15 A mountain or mountainous range, the mountains of the moon.
n. (-मं)
1 Rice-water or gruel.
2 Heaven, sky, æther.
E.
षू to bear, (as young,) or to sprinkle, Uṇādi aff. मन्.

m. (-र्ब्भः)
VIṢṆU.
E.
सोम the moon, and गर्ब्भ embryo.

n. (-जं)
Milk.
E.
सोम the moon, and ज produced.

m. (-र्थः)
A place of pilgrimage in the west of India.
E.
सोम the moon, and तीर्थ a holy place.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
Presided over by SOMA.
E.
सोम, and दैवत्य deification.

f. (-रा)
Sky, heaven.
E.
सोम the moon, धारा having.

m. (-मा)
The moon.
E.
षू to bring forth, (as young,) and मनिन् aff.

m. (-पः)
The performer of a sacrifice, or a sacrificer, who drinks the juice of the acid Sarcostema.
E.
सोम the plant, and प who drinks.

m. (-पाः)
1 A drinker of the juice of the acid

Sarcostema.
2

A Pitṛ or progenitor of a certain class, or those who are especially the Pitṛs of the Brahmans.
E.
सोम the acid Sarcostema, and पा to drink, aff. क्विप्.

m. (-त्रः)
A sort of grass, (Saccharum cylindricum.)
E.
सोम the Sarcostema, and पच a leaf.

n. (-नं)
Drinking the juice of the acid Sarcostema, an essential part of sacrifices according to the Veda ritual.
E.
सोम, and पान drinking.

m. (-ती)
A drinker of the juice of the acid Sarcostema.
E.
सोम the juice of the plant, पीति beverage, इनि aff.; it is also read सोमपीथिन् and सोमपीविन्.

m. (-न्धुः)
The white esculent water-lily.
E.
सोम the moon, and बन्धु friend; expanding at night.

m. (-भूः)
1 One of the persons called VĀSUDEVAS, by the

Jainas.
2

The son of SOMA, BUDHA, the regent of MERCURY, and supposed founder of the lunar dynasty.
E.
सोम the moon, and भू born.

m. (-गः)
Offering or sacrifice in which the acid Sarcostema juice is drank.
E.
सोम, and याग sacrifice.

m. (-जी)
A sacrificer who drinks at the ceremony the juice of the acid Sarcostema.
E.
सोम the plant, यज to sacrifice, णिनि aff.

m. (-निः)
A sort of Sandal of yellow colour and great fragrance.
E.
सोम the moon, and योनि place of production.

m. (-जी)
A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
E.
सोम the moon, राज to shine, aff. णिनि, or with अच् and ङीष् added, सोमराजी; and again with कन् added, सोमराजिका.

f. (-जी)
1 A medicinal plant: see the last.

f. (-ता)
1 The moon-plant or acid Sarcostema, (S. viminalis.)
2 The Godāvarī river.
E.
सोम, and लता a creeper.

m. (-शः)
1 A name of YUDHIṢṬ

HIRA.
2

The lunar dynasty, or series of princes supposed to descend through BUDHA from SOMA, or the moon.
E.
सोम, and वंश family.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Lunar, having the moon.
2 Having the Sarcostema juice.
E.
सोम, and मतुप् aff.

ind.
Like the moon.
E.
सोम, and वति aff.

m. (-ल्कः)
1 A white kind of Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.)
2 A medicinal plant, commonly

Kayaphal.
3

A plant, (Guilandina bonduccella.)
E.
सोम the moon, and वल्क bark.

f. (-रिः-री)
The moon-plant, (Sarcostema viminalis.)
E.
सोम the moon, and वल्लरी a creeper.

f. (-ल्ली)
1 A twining plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
2 A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
3 The moonplant.
E.
सोम the moon, and वल्ली a creeper.

m. (-रः)
Monday.
E.
सोम, and वार a day.

m. (-यी)
A vender of the juice of the acid Sarcostema.
E.
सोम the plant, विक्रय selling, and इनि aff.

m. (-क्षः)
1 A medicinal plant, (Kayaphal.)
2 A shrub, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
E.
सोम the moon, and वृक्ष a tree.

n. (-ज्ञं)
Camphor.
E.
सोम the moon, and सज्ञ appellation.

m. (-सद्)
A Pitṛ or progenitor of a peculiar class, the progenitor of the celestial beings called Sādhyas.
E.
सोम, and सद् who goes.

m. (-न्तः)
1 One of the

Buddhas.
2

A rationalist of a sect of Śaivas.
3 A particular doctrine, a system of theological philosophy, followed by a branch of the worshippers of ŚIVA.
E.
सोम the moon, (as the teacher of the doctrine,) and सिद्धान्त truth, (whose.)

m. (-न्ती)
A follower of a branch of the Śaivas.
E.
सोमसिद्धान्त the doctrine, and इनि aff.

m. (-न्धुः)
VIṢṆU.

m. (-सुत्)
A priest or sacrificer who sprinkles the juice of the acid Sarcostema at a sacrifice.
E.
सोम the plant, षु to sprinkle, aff. क्विप्.

mfn. (-त्वान्-त्वती-त्वत्)
Having sprinklers of Soma juice, (a hermitage, a sacrifice, &c.)
E.
सोमसुत्, and मतुप् aff.

f. (-ता)
The Narmadā or Nerbudda river.
E.
सोम the moon, and सुता daughter.

n. (-ख्यं)
The red lotus.
E.
सोम the moon, and आख्या appellation.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Soft, bland.
E.
सोम the moon, अल to resemble, aff. अच.

f. (-वा)
The Narmadā or Nerbudda river.
E.
सोम the moon, (for the lunar race,) and उद्भव born; or सोम nectar, उद्भव production, (from it,) by conferring paradise on those who bathe in it.
